director.text: Namaste Riya! Main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj fractions ko number line par cricket pitch jaise dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan, samajh aaya

Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai. Achha, Riya.
haan samajh gayi
Screen par 0 se 1 ki line hai, theek beech ka mark 2 barabar gaps banata hai: 1/2. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: near 3

1/3 mein 3 parts banate hain, 3 par nahi. Screen par ghar se chai ki dukaan tak ki sadak hai, 0 se 1 km, aur ek khilona beech wale mark par ruka hai. Woh sadak ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka number 1/2 km hai, 0 aur 1 ke beech. Wahi 0 se 1 km ki sadak ab 8 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Khilona pehle hisse ke end par ruka. Woh kis number par hai?
director.card: Wahi 0 se 1 km ki sadak ab 8 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Khilona pehle hisse ke end par ruka. Woh kis number par hai?

Screen par wahi 0 se 1 ki line hai, par ab beech mein 3 marks hain. Marks nahi, gaps dekho: 4 barabar gaps hain, isliye 0 ke baad pehla mark 1/4 hai. Agar 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par lage hon, toh line kitne barabar gaps mein bategi?

Bilkul, Riya—pehla pole 0 aur 1 km ke beech pehla barabar gap banata hai. Aur pehle wale sawaal ka jawab 1/10 tha, kyunki pehla mark 1/8 hai, bilkul 0 ke paas, aur beech wala mark abhi bhi 1/2 hai. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 km par. Ghar aur school ke beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par lage hain. Pehla khamba ghar se kitne km door hai? Diya hai: ghar 0 par, school 1 km par, beech mein 3 khambe, barabar doori par. Dhoondhna hai: pehle khambe ki ghar se doori, km mein. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
haan, samajh aaya
3 poles se 4 equal gaps bante hain. Line banao aur ghar ko 0 par, school ko 1 par likho: 0 se 1 tak ki line, kyunki 0 se 1 tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
mujhe lagta hai haan
3 poles se 4 equal gaps bante hain. Khambe nahi, beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe, toh 4 barabar hisse, kyunki beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain. Ab tak samajh aaya?
pata nahi, aap batao
3 khambe 4 barabar gaps banate hain. Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?

director.text: 0 aur 1 ke beech

Sahi, 1/2, 0 aur 1 ke beech hota hai. Ab tak humne 0 se sirf ek gap liya, jaise 1/4. Agle hisse mein 0 se 2 ya 3 gap chalenge, aur upar ka number batayega ki kitne gap chalna hai. Screen par 0 se 1 ki line 3 barabar gaps mein bati hai. 0 se 2 hop lage hain, har hop 1/3 ka, aur hum 2/3 wale mark par pahunche. 2/3 ek hi jagah hai, ek hi number. Ab line ko 4 barabar gaps mein baanto aur 0 se 3 hop lo. Kis fraction par pahunchoge?
director.card: Ab line ko 4 barabar gaps mein baanto aur 0 se 3 hop lo. Kis fraction par pahunchoge?

director.text: teen bata chaar
Bilkul, Riya—tumne 3 hops ko 3/4 likha. Tumhe kaise pata chala ki neeche 4 aayega?
jodte jodte aaya

Screen par teesra hop dekho: woh theek 1 par utra, aur wahan likha hai 3/3 = 1. 3/3 mein upar aur neeche barabar hain, isliye hop theek 1 par khatam hue. Agar har hop 1/5 ka ho, toh 0 se chalkar theek 1 tak pahunchne mein kitne hop lagenge?
director.card: Agar har hop 1/5 ka ho, toh 0 se chalkar theek 1 tak pahunchne mein kitne hop lagenge?

haan, samajh aaya

Ab dekhenge ki upar ka number bada ho toh hop 1 ke aage kaise jaate hain. Screen par line 0 se 2 tak hai. Har poora 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur 1 wale mark par likha hai 4/4 = 1. Gaps 1 ke aage bhi usi size mein chalte rehte hain. Ab ek line socho jahan har hop 1/3 ka hai. 0 se 4 hop lo. Tum 1 se pehle rukoge ya 1 ke baad?
